# TutorTerm Calculator

> Fee calculator for a Melbourne tutoring business (Grade Prep through VCE, terms/holidays
> for 2026–2030). Built to be usable by an AI agent without clicking through the UI: the
> same quote the page renders is available as structured data, via the URL, and via a JS
> function — pick whichever fits how you're driving the page.

## Query-string state

The full calculator state round-trips through the URL query string (read once on load,
written back — debounced — on every change). A URL is a complete, self-describing
snapshot; navigating to one renders the real, calculated quote with no clicks required.

    ?year=2026&lang=en&client=loyalty&level=vce&credit=50&debit=20
     &slots=term_1,gr_hols_2
     &term_1=monday~1h~2026-01-28~2026-04-02
     &gr_hols_2_dates=0627,0703

- `year`, `lang` (`en`|`zh`), `client` (`loyalty`|`new`), `level` (`prep_6`|`grade_7_10`|`vce`|`adult`) — scalars.
- `credit`, `debit` — free-text dollar amounts, omitted from the URL when empty.
- `slots` — comma-joined list of active slot keys (see `window.tutorterm.slots` below).
- `<slotKey>=<day>~<duration>~<start>~<end>` — one param per active slot: lowercase day name
  (`monday`…`sunday`), a duration key, ISO start/end dates. `~`-delimited, not `.`-delimited —
  the `1.5h` duration key contains a literal `.`, which a `.`-delimited format can't express.
  Present but not user-editable for holiday slots (their date range is fixed).
- `<slotKey>_dates=<MMdd>,<MMdd>,…` — per-slot holiday date selections, month+day only
  (public holidays are excluded automatically, same as the UI).
- Malformed or unrecognised values fall back to their default silently, field by field — a
  hand-edited or fuzzed URL never crashes the page or drops an otherwise-valid sibling field.

## Structured quote mirror

Every render mirrors the current quote as JSON in the page itself, present even when no
slots are active:

    JSON.parse(document.getElementById('quote-data').textContent)

Shape: `{ inputs: {year, level, client, lang, rate}, slots: [...], totals: {subtotal,
discount, discountKind, credit, debit, payable} }`.

## window.tutorterm — JS API

Available as soon as the page's script runs, before React hydrates. Call
`window.tutorterm.help()` (from the console, or any tool executing JS in the page) for a
machine-readable description of the full surface plus a worked example. Summary:

- `calculate(params) -> QuoteData` — the pure function everything above is built on.
- `formatTape(quote) -> TapeLine[]` — the exact printed tape lines (what "Copy quote"
  copies), in whichever language `quote.inputs.lang` was.
- `yearData[year] -> { terms, holidays, publicHolidays }` — real date ranges; no need to
  hand-type or remember term/holiday dates.
- `getCurrentYear()`, `getAvailableYears()`.
- `slots -> [{key, termKey, isHols, isGR, n}, …]` — every valid slot key.
- `levels -> { [levelKey]: { rates: [loyaltyRate, newClientRate] } }`.
- `durations -> { [durationKey]: hours }`.
- `version` — build hash (matches the footer on the page).

Example — a T1 CLASS quote with no hand-typed literals except the day/level choice:

    const t = window.tutorterm;
    const year = t.getCurrentYear();
    const data = t.yearData[year];
    const slot = t.slots.find(s => s.key === "term_1");
    const quote = t.calculate({
      active: [slot.key],
      configs: { [slot.key]: {
        day: "Monday", dur: "1h", start: data.terms.term_1.start, end: data.terms.term_1.end,
        groupReading: false, selectedDates: [],
      } },
      level: "vce", loyal: true, year, data, globalCredit: "", globalDebit: "", lang: "en",
    });
    t.formatTape(quote).map(l => l.text).join("\n");
